caption: The drawing depicts a toy-like scene featuring three horses harnessed side by side in front of a mechanical vehicle that resembles a steam-powered fire engine, all of which are positioned in the center against a plain, off-white background. The horses are colored brown, tan, and black/yellow, each with blue hooves, harnesses, and reins. The vehicle has large red spoked wheels, metallic gray machinery, and a tall cylindrical component at the back, resembling a steam boiler. Seated on the vehicle is a human figure dressed in yellow pants, a red shirt, and a tan hat, holding the reins of the horses. The composition is minimal, with no background elements except for the labeled name "William Schreiner" and some faint text in the bottom right corner.
title: Toy Fire Engine
